default.hint: Arrows: move   X/Z: A/B   S/A: X/Y   Enter: Start   Q/W: L/R   F1: all controls
default.description:
Move: arrow keys
A: X    B: Z
SNES X: S    SNES Y: A
Start: Enter    Select: Backspace
L: Q    R: W

Controller: d-pad / left stick, east=A, south=B, north=X, west=Y, Start, Back and shoulders.

n64.hint: Arrows: stick   X/Z: A/B   Space: Z trigger   I/J/K/L: C buttons   Enter: Start   F1: controls
n64.description:
Control stick: arrow keys
A: X    B: Z    Z trigger: Space
C buttons: I (up), J (left), K (down), L (right)
L/R shoulders: Q/W    Start: Enter
D-pad: T/F/G/H

Controller: left stick = control stick, right stick = C buttons, south = A, west = B, left trigger = Z, shoulders = L/R, Start and d-pad.

dreamcast.hint: Arrows: stick   X/Z: A/B   A/S: X/Y   Q/W: triggers   Enter: Start   F1: controls
dreamcast.description:
Analog stick: arrow keys
A: X    B: Z    X: A    Y: S
L/R triggers: Q/W    Start: Enter
D-pad: T/F/G/H

Controller: left stick, d-pad, south=A, east=B, west=X, north=Y, triggers or shoulders=L/R, Start.
